title: Button
description: Buttons for primary actions, secondary actions and destructive actions, with disabled and loading examples.
usage: One primary action per view. Use Secondary for the alternative, Ghost for tertiary actions, Danger only for destructive ones.
a11y: Native buttons with explicit types; no JavaScript. Keyboard focus shows --k-ring (2px gap plus 2px ink ring, measured at 3:1 in light and dark). Primary, Secondary, Ghost, Accent and Danger each have hover, pressed and disabled styles; enabled text measures at least 5.5:1 in every state in both themes (docs/review/button). Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading examples keep their text and add disabled with aria-busy, and their spinner is aria-hidden and stops with prefers-reduced-motion. btn-asagi is a deprecated alias of btn-accent. Owner-reported VoiceOver pass on iPhone, 2026-11-06, without a transcript (docs/review/button/screen-reader.md); NVDA not tested. IME does not apply because a button takes no text input. Checked in Chromium only; Safari and Firefox are not yet verified.
